name: Refine v5 Syntax Review
description: When a React/TypeScript file is saved, check it for Refine v4 hook syntax that silently breaks on v5.

then.prompt: Review the saved file for Refine v4 patterns that break on v5: destructuring `data` from useList/useOne/useMany/useShow instead of `result`, reading `.data.data`, using `isLoading` on a mutation instead of `mutation.isPending`, `tableQueryResult` from useDataGrid, or the renamed params `metaData`, `sorter`, `hasPagination`, `initialCurrent`, `initialPageSize`. Also flag unstable hook arguments (inline `new Date()`, fresh object/array literals in filters/sorters/meta) that cause refetch loops. If the file is clean, say nothing. If you find issues, list the exact line and the v5 replacement.
